log.label: Tables
log.sql:
SELECT TABLE_NAME AS name, TABLE_TYPE AS kind, ENGINE AS engine, TABLE_ROWS AS estimated_rows,
       DATA_LENGTH AS data_bytes, INDEX_LENGTH AS index_bytes, AVG_ROW_LENGTH AS avg_row_bytes,
       AUTO_INCREMENT AS auto_increment, TABLE_COMMENT AS comment, CREATE_TIME AS created_at
  FROM information_schema.TABLES
 WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = DATABASE()
 ORDER BY name

log.label: Columns
log.sql:
SELECT TABLE_NAME AS table_name, ORDINAL_POSITION AS position, COLUMN_NAME AS name,
       COLUMN_TYPE AS type, DATA_TYPE AS data_type, IS_NULLABLE AS nullable,
       COLUMN_DEFAULT AS default_value, EXTRA AS extra, COLUMN_COMMENT AS comment
  FROM information_schema.COLUMNS
 WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = DATABASE()
 ORDER BY table_name, position

log.label: Indexes and keys
log.sql:
SELECT TABLE_NAME AS table_name, INDEX_NAME AS name, NON_UNIQUE AS non_unique,
       SEQ_IN_INDEX AS seq, COLUMN_NAME AS column_name, INDEX_TYPE AS type, CARDINALITY AS cardinality
  FROM information_schema.STATISTICS
 WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = DATABASE()
 ORDER BY table_name, name, seq

log.label: Foreign keys
log.sql:
SELECT TABLE_NAME AS table_name, CONSTRAINT_NAME AS name, COLUMN_NAME AS column_name,
       REFERENCED_TABLE_NAME AS ref_table, REFERENCED_COLUMN_NAME AS ref_column
  FROM information_schema.KEY_COLUMN_USAGE
 WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = DATABASE() AND REFERENCED_TABLE_NAME IS NOT NULL
 ORDER BY table_name, name, ORDINAL_POSITION

log.label: Check constraints
log.sql:
SELECT tc.TABLE_NAME AS table_name, cc.CONSTRAINT_NAME AS name, cc.CHECK_CLAUSE AS predicate
  FROM information_schema.CHECK_CONSTRAINTS cc
  JOIN information_schema.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS tc
    ON tc.CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA = cc.CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA AND tc.CONSTRAINT_NAME = cc.CONSTRAINT_NAME
 WHERE cc.CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA = DATABASE()
 ORDER BY table_name, name

log.label: Column statistics, specimens
log.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS `rows`,
       COUNT(DISTINCT `id`) AS `id.distinct`,
       SUM(`id` IS NULL) AS `id.nulls`,
       MIN(`id`) AS `id.min`,
       MAX(`id`) AS `id.max`,
       COUNT(DISTINCT `latin_name`) AS `latin_name.distinct`,
       SUM(`latin_name` IS NULL) AS `latin_name.nulls`,
       COUNT(DISTINCT `common_name`) AS `common_name.distinct`,
       SUM(`common_name` IS NULL) AS `common_name.nulls`,
       COUNT(DISTINCT `family`) AS `family.distinct`,
       SUM(`family` IS NULL) AS `family.nulls`,
       COUNT(DISTINCT `locality`) AS `locality.distinct`,
       SUM(`locality` IS NULL) AS `locality.nulls`,
       COUNT(DISTINCT `collected_on`) AS `collected_on.distinct`,
       SUM(`collected_on` IS NULL) AS `collected_on.nulls`,
       MIN(`collected_on`) AS `collected_on.min`,
       MAX(`collected_on`) AS `collected_on.max`,
       COUNT(DISTINCT `collector`) AS `collector.distinct`,
       SUM(`collector` IS NULL) AS `collector.nulls`,
       COUNT(DISTINCT `object_key`) AS `object_key.distinct`,
       SUM(`object_key` IS NULL) AS `object_key.nulls`,
       COUNT(DISTINCT `content_type`) AS `content_type.distinct`,
       SUM(`content_type` IS NULL) AS `content_type.nulls`,
       COUNT(DISTINCT `byte_size`) AS `byte_size.distinct`,
       SUM(`byte_size` IS NULL) AS `byte_size.nulls`,
       MIN(`byte_size`) AS `byte_size.min`,
       MAX(`byte_size`) AS `byte_size.max`,
       COUNT(DISTINCT `drawing`) AS `drawing.distinct`,
       SUM(`drawing` IS NULL) AS `drawing.nulls`,
       COUNT(DISTINCT `seed_key`) AS `seed_key.distinct`,
       SUM(`seed_key` IS NULL) AS `seed_key.nulls`,
       SUM(`created_sql` IS NULL) AS `created_sql.nulls`,
       COUNT(DISTINCT `created_at`) AS `created_at.distinct`,
       SUM(`created_at` IS NULL) AS `created_at.nulls`,
       MIN(`created_at`) AS `created_at.min`,
       MAX(`created_at`) AS `created_at.max`
  FROM `specimens`

log.label: Common values, specimens.locality
log.sql:
SELECT `locality` AS value, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM `specimens`
 GROUP BY `locality`
 ORDER BY n DESC, value
 LIMIT 6

log.label: Common values, specimens.collector
log.sql:
SELECT `collector` AS value, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM `specimens`
 GROUP BY `collector`
 ORDER BY n DESC, value
 LIMIT 6

log.label: Common values, specimens.content_type
log.sql:
SELECT `content_type` AS value, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM `specimens`
 GROUP BY `content_type`
 ORDER BY n DESC, value
 LIMIT 6
